name: tome-of-abyssal-heaven-other-ally-has-spellshroud-spell-finds-no-target
notes: Tome of Abyssal Heaven: other allies you control have spellshroud (a spell finds no target). Tome of Abyssal Heaven (igmC01eEZn): "Other objects you control have spellshroud." Player 2 controls the Tome and a Dungeon Guide (an ordinary ally); player 1 plays Liturgy of Corruption ("Put a buff counter on target ally ..."). The Dungeon Guide is shrouded by the Tome, so the spell finds no legal target, resolves without a prompt, and the Guide gets no buff counter (without the Tome the same spell would prompt for a target).

rulesClauses: Tome of Abyssal Heaven: other objects you control have spellshroud, so a spell finds no legal ally target.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Tome of Abyssal Heaven's static "Other objects you control have spellshroud." was not implemented anywhere (no clause in HasSpellshroud()). Evidence on HEAD 48faaae9 (this fixture, run against the unfixed Custom/GameLogic.php): Liturgy of Corruption's target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-2' -- the Dungeon Guide was offered although it is an 'other object' of the Tome's controller. Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for any field object whose controller controls an ability-bearing Tome (excluding the Tome itself), after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for igmC01eEZn; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
